mathematical_contract.selection_rule: the authored predicate is branch > 0; branch = 0 contributes neither a positive-dimensional overlap endpoint nor an isolated contact
mathematical_contract.closure_rule: each overlap retains exact oriented closure bounds plus two explicit endpoint-inclusion bits; an excluded branch zero splits adjacent selected intervals into open-sided overlaps
mathematical_contract.rational_rule: the restricted univariate branch polynomial is isolated exactly once, every retained monotone domain is split at its roots, and each open subinterval is classified from an exact interior sample
mathematical_contract.implicit_rule: component/branch intersections are enumerated as exact event points and merged with critical, singular, and authored-boundary fibers before cylindrical incidence traversal
mathematical_contract.singular_rule: a branch zero coincident with a cusp or other singular event preserves every incident selected half-branch while excluding the shared vertex
mathematical_contract.residual_rule: excluded component pairs survive exact factor division and are checked before overlap-boundary and residual replay, so a divided residual cannot rediscover a strict zero
mathematical_contract.degenerate_residual_rule: an unresolved degenerate residual with exclusion evidence is reported incomplete instead of replaying the original system without those exclusions
mathematical_contract.orientation_rule: retaining the second parameter and traversing a decreasing lift reverses both range orientation and endpoint-inclusion ownership
mathematical_contract.policy_rule: APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only inherited equality, ordering, and sign predicates at 512 bits; it never invents a root, event, factor, sign, inclusion bit, or contact
mathematical_contract.hot_path_rule: the historical Boolean no-solution projection remains first for ordinary implicit cells; exact point enumeration runs only after that guard proves a branch zero exists

implementation_evidence.rational_partition: exact branch roots split rational component domains; zero roots at authored or mapped-domain endpoints clear only the corresponding ownership bit
implementation_evidence.implicit_partition: branch-zero events participate in the same sorted fiber and incidence graph as folds, turns, singularities, and square boundaries
implementation_evidence.isolated_points: a zero-dimensional component point is selected only when branch > 0 and becomes exclusion evidence when branch = 0
implementation_evidence.residual_suppression: a fixture in which the divided residual solution equals the component puncture remains projected but is removed before exact contact construction
implementation_evidence.non_rational_coefficients: a translated component with an exact irrational Real coefficient partitions at its defining exact branch root under both policies
implementation_evidence.lean_projection: the no-default-features test matrix uses an equally exact supported alternate retained axis where algebraic-fiber predicates are feature-gated; the all-feature matrix exercises the local-field axis
implementation_evidence.feature_gate_experiment: globally enabling algebraic-fiber predicates in the lean build caused severe ordinary-path regressions and was fully reverted

storage_layout_bytes.interpretation: selected and excluded component pairs share one Arc slice and one split index; public overlap objects consume existing padding, while each internal carrier adds one machine word and no second allocation

benchmark_method.ordering: fresh immutable binaries interleaved in rotating parent, initial, and final order
benchmark_method.source_identity: benches/offset.rs is byte-identical across all three revisions
benchmark_method.discarded_measurements: runs affected by the exhausted sandbox mount wrapper or visibly nonstationary unpinned machine load were not admitted

performance_interpretation.initial_observation: eager branch-zero point enumeration made the ordinary implicit-cell process 1.18 percent slower than the final revision and moved the two-turning lanes about 2.0 to 2.1 percent
performance_interpretation.followup: the historical exact Boolean no-solution guard now returns before point collection; branch-zero cases pay a second exact projection only on the cold exceptional path
performance_interpretation.final_observation: the final complete-process median is 0.30 percent faster than the parent, and every established general implicit median is within -0.32 to +0.37 percent of the parent
performance_interpretation.small_lane_boundary: the microsecond boundary-fiber lane is 0.58 to 0.76 percent slower than parent while the complete process and dominant implicit lanes remain neutral or faster
performance_interpretation.claim_boundary: the parent cannot complete the new isolated-zero selected topology, so matched historical lanes are no-regression guards rather than a throughput ratio for the new mathematical case

hardware_counters.method: three fresh pinned complete benchmark-group processes per revision under perf stat with 100 percent event coverage

memory.rss_method: the same five interleaved fresh pinned benchmark processes measured with /usr/bin/time
memory.heaptrack_method: one direct, unpinned complete benchmark-group process per parent and final revision; timing under instrumentation is not used
memory.interpretation: the shared selected/excluded pair allocation and zero-free guard remove 200 process-wide allocation calls, add no temporary allocation, and add no rounded peak heap

release_size.interpretation: complete isolated-zero topology adds 0.113 percent text versus parent; the hot guard costs 404 text bytes versus the initial semantic cut while recovering 1.18 percent complete-process throughput

static_callgraph.scope: hypercurve and hypersolve with examples, tests, benchmarks, and fuzz targets
static_callgraph.interpretation: growth covers explicit endpoint ownership, isolated-zero event/evidence transport, residual exclusion, the hot guard, and direct both-policy topology tests

competitive_context.method: three all-feature comparative release processes; each reports the median of eleven calibrated 100 ms samples pinned to CPU 11, and the checkpoint reports the median process
competitive_context.reason: Cavalier Contours and Curvo operate in finite f64 or heuristic models and do not expose exact isolated branch-zero topology, bivariate component division, or STRICT/APPROXIMATE_512 semantics
competitive_context.interpretation: competitive controls remain optimization targets, not correctness-equivalent substitutes; the first capsule process was disturbed, and the median-of-processes protocol prevents that outlier from becoming the reported value
